description: This file defines a repository class for managing high water mark data related to billing, including methods for retrieving, updating, and resetting high water mark records, with integration to Prisma ORM.

classes.name: HighWaterMarkRepository
classes.description: Repository class for handling high water mark billing data, including retrieval, updates, and resets.

methods.name: getByTeamId
methods.description: Retrieves high water mark data for a specific team, considering whether it's an organization or individual team.

methods.name: getBySubscriptionId
methods.description: Fetches high water mark data based on a subscription ID, checking both team and organization billing records.

methods.name: updateIfHigher
methods.description: Updates the high water mark if the new seat count is higher or if it's a new billing period.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the high water mark and period start for a team or organization.

methods.name: updateQuantityAfterStripeSync
methods.description: Updates the paid seats quantity after synchronization with Stripe.
